test_command: No test command. Per-feature verification scripts/HTTP checks are listed in each FEAT file. contribution_requirements: Keep changes focused; do not refactor unrelated code. Match existing style (type hints, docstrings at module top, pydantic v2 with from_attributes). Shared files (api.js, App.jsx, Layout.jsx, Help.jsx, styles.css, Dashboard.jsx, models.py, schemas.py, main.py) are edited by several features: ALWAYS re-read the file immediately before editing. Append CSS as one commented block per feature at the end of styles.css, using theme variables from the :root block (--color-ink-navy, --color-orange, --color-slate-gray, --color-pebble, --color-success, --color-danger, --color-butter-soft, etc.).
key_patterns: Routers: `router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/x", tags=[...])`, `db: Session = Depends(get_db)`, auth via `get_current_teacher` / `require_hod` (app/security.py), HTTPException 404/403/409/400, audit via `audit.log(db, actor_id=, action=, entity=, entity_id=, detail=)`, notifications via `notify(db, teacher, title, body)` (app/services/notifications.py), commit at the end of the endpoint. Routers registered in app/main.py via `app.include_router`. Frontend: pages in src/pages use `PageHeader` (badge,title,subtitle,children), `.card`, `.card-head`, `.pill blue|green|red|amber|gray`, `.seg/.seg-btn.active`, `.row/.col`, `.scroll-x` table wrapper, `SkeletonRows`/`SkeletonStats` (components/Skeleton.jsx), `.stat-row-4/.stat-tile.{blue,green,red,amber}` tiles (Dashboard), `.bar-track/.bar-fill` bars (Fairness.jsx), `.lab-tag`, `.sub-tag`. api.js `request(path,{method,body})` helper with bearer token; `api.x` object. Nav = `liveNav` array in components/Layout.jsx (icons from components/Icons.jsx; `hod:true` hides for teachers). Routes in src/App.jsx (`<Protected hodOnly>` for HOD-only). Help.jsx has `TOPICS` and `FAQS` arrays (`hod:true` flag, `tags`). TimetableGrid keys cells by `${day_of_week}_${period_index}` and reads e.subject.name, e.class_section.name, e.teacher.name, e.co_teacher, e.room.name, e.is_double.
directory_structure: backend/app/{models.py,schemas.py,main.py,config.py,database.py,security.py}, backend/app/routers/{accounts,auth,dashboard,leaves,notifications,reference,substitutions,timetable}.py, backend/app/services/{ai_assist,audit,notifications,substitution_engine,timetable_generator}.py, backend/.venv. frontend/src/{api.js,App.jsx,auth.jsx,main.jsx,styles.css}, frontend/src/pages/*.jsx, frontend/src/components/*.jsx.
